reading: The order of the work as a staircase of equal steps, each one step to the right of the one before, so position shows order only and widths mean nothing; each row with its measure: measure first; a works agreement whose framework is agreed while planning, with a thin line running on to the end and a new annex at each permission stage; choose suppliers; train staff; one customer record; permissions in stages (read only, then undoable actions, then changes fraud could use), each opened only after a test set passes; acceptance, signed off by the staff who will work with it; and running it, which leads back to measuring. Arrows show that the works agreement, the trained staff and the customer record must come before the first permission. A band along the bottom: the staff stay throughout. At the end of the axis: Telekom's target, 2030.
headline: Each step unlocks the next. The staff stay, and every permission is tested first.
note: Each step sits one place to the right of the step it follows. Positions show order and dependency only; every step has the same width, and no duration or date is measured. The only date drawn is Telekom's own target year at the end of the axis (R6-03).
